# The Neuron Times

> All the AI that's fit to print. Daily AI watch broadsheet newspaper, published every morning at 7am CET, with a weekly recap on Mondays.

The Neuron Times synthesizes 84 canonical AI sources (frontier labs, release notes, leaderboards, research papers) into a structured 4-page broadsheet edition published every morning at 7am CET. Topics covered: models, coding agents, inference engines, research, ecosystem signals. Multilingual: French, English, German, Italian, Lombard.

## Structure

Each edition contains: Lead story (headline + subdeck + byline + full body), Sidebar with 4 wire dispatches, Page 1 (Models & Frontier), Page 2 (Technical Review), Page 3 (Research), Page 4 (Labs Roundup + Editorial). All sources cited with clickable URLs. Content available in 5 languages (fr, en, de, it, lmo) from the same URL via CSS language switching.
